The Node binding gains no generator or drift gate: tests tie the limit to the contract's event_max_bytes (decision 2 of the #945 triage).

evidence_ids: tests refuse an occurrence one byte over the limit, one well over it, an oversized not_committed one, an oversized wrong-class one, an oversized string and an oversized repeat of a settled pair as occurrence_too_large with zero probe, gate and handoff calls, keep a corrected pair deliverable, and each fails against its planted defect

an occurrence of exactly the contract's limit in UTF-8 bytes is delivered with one exchange whose body is that size, an occurrence under the limit in characters and over it in bytes is refused, and the off-by-one and character-count plants fail their tests

every size test builds its occurrence from bounds.event_max_bytes read from the contract source and runs through the public entry, for admission and for the handoff called directly; the handoff's module declares the limit once; and the plants that change the constant or give the handoff another literal fail their tests
npm run test:exports reports 19 value and 44 type-only exports, and compatibility.json gains one freezeRecord amendment naming occurrence_too_large with earlier amendments byte-identical
the README row and migration note, ADR-NODE-008 with its two known limits and the ADR-NODE-007 pointer state the size refusal, its timing and its code as the MODIFIED requirement does
